title: Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order Amendment Act 2011

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order Amendment Act 2011
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 2011
ACT III OF 2011
BALOCHISTAN MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC
ORDER (AMENDMENT) ACT, 201'1
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order
Ordinance, 1960 (XXXI of 1960)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
2nd April, 2010]
No.PAB/Legis:V
(03)/2011, dated 2-4-2011.--Having been passed the Balochistan Maintenance of
Public Order (Amendment) Bill No.3 of 2011, by the Provincial Assembly of
Balochistan on 29th March, 2011 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan on
31st March, 2011 is hereby published as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial
Assembly.
Preamble.--Whereas, it is expedient further to amend the
Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960 (XXXI of 1960) in the
manner hereinafter appearing.
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the Balochistan Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Act,
2011.
(2) It extends to the whole of Province of Balochistan
except the tribal areas.
(3) It shall come into force at once.
